title: 1BR Mins from Gaylord/Opryland - Private Balcony
description:
Welcome all music fanatics! Feel inspired to sing your favorite songs in this 'tunes' themed unit located at The Lodge. Enjoy a home cooked meal in our full kitchen with top of the line appliances! Whether you are in town to work or play, this unit is versatile to ensure you have what you need while in Nashville. 

☆Groceries just across the street!
☆Access to Gym & Steam Room
☆Just miles from the Gaylord Convention Center
☆Private Balcony
☆EV Charger
★No pets 
★No parties 
★No smoking

The space
Our King bed + Queen sofa bed unit is a one bedroom apartment with a full bathroom and fully equipped eat-in kitchen. You will be welcomed by a keypad entry creating a seamless check in process. The sleeping space includes a king bed and a queen sofa bed with soft linens and a plush duvet! The kitchen will inspire you to whip up a great meal, with top of the line appliances and ample counter space. There is a Kroger grocery store just across the street from the Lodge for any last minute groceries items or late night snacking needs that may come up! Have an electric vehicle? We have an exclusive EV charger just for you in our parking lot. The in unit washer & dryer is located in the bedroom for your convenience. Music is important to us, so we've created a unit that inspires our guests to get out and get groovin'! Once settled, guests can also explore the building's amenities, including a fitness center! 

☆Enjoy some sun on the balcony! 
☆Plush King Bed: Drift asleep on the comfiest king bed with soft linen and a plush duvet. 
☆Queen sofa bed: For additional sleeping space, our queen sofa bed creates a versatile living/sleeping area.
☆Smart TV: Want a movie night in or binge your favorite shows? The smart TV allows guests to access their streaming services featured on the TV. 
☆Luxury Bathroom: The full bathroom with a tub shower ensures a spa-like experience.
☆In-unit laundry: Our premium washer & dryer is offered for our guests convenience! 
☆Work Space: if working from home when in Nashville, our guests are provided with a dedicated work space to ensure they have the space they need to do so.

Guest access
Guests will have access to their private unit, ample free outdoor parking on premises, and by request only, the building gym and steam room. To obtain access to the building gym and steam room, please review the house rules section and contact our team for directions and access!

Further direction to access the property and your unit will be sent to you via text message the day before your arrival.

Other things to note
**IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR MORE SPACE OR DIFFERENT SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS, REACH OUT TO US AS WE HAVE MULTIPLE UNITS IN THE BUILDING!

★Upon booking, guests will receive a text from our team with a rental agreement. The agreement is to acknowledge our house rules as well as provide your email address which allows us to invite you to the door app for check in!
★Further direction to access the property and your unit will be sent to you via text message the day before your arrival.
★Rest assured, our team is around 24/7 for any emergency that may arise.
★ Review our additional rules for our mandatory Gym Liability acknowledgment.
★ NO PETS, parties or any smoking of any kind allowed. 
★NO SMOKING, the property is 100% smoke free. No smoking in the unit, building, or on any balcony. There is a $300 minimum fine for any evidence of smoking or smell mitigation required. 
★For tips on places to eat, things to do, & all things #Nashville find us on insta! @urbannashvacations. Ask us about our Linktree for awesome deals & partnerships we have!
★Check-in is at 4 pm // Check out is at 10 am. If you're looking to check in early or check out late, we suggest booking the night before or after your arrival. Otherwise, to be considerate to other guests, we cannot guarantee that an early check-in or late check-out request will be accommodated. Feel free to arrive anytime after 4 pm.
